meta.name: Overlay effect recipes
meta.description: Synthetic review fixture for the six builder recipes: each scene layers two engine primitives (graphics[] fx, frame and corners) anchored to the card.
meta.creativeDirection: Direction: an honest synthetic test fixture for six two-part recipes built from engine primitives. Frame an interface detail, light a product card, mark a celebration, lock focus, pass a warm light or reveal a fine frame. Every effect is anchored to the card (target layer:0) and tuned on top of the recipe defaults. Keep labels readable and the focal element visible, with a clear hold after each effect. Avoid treating these shapes as a real app demonstration. Review entrance, strongest frame, completion, target visibility and both bright and dark backgrounds.

text.en: A brief wash. Keep the image clear.
